description: §19.10.2-§19.10.3 `transaction { }` inside a `!` FUNCTION body (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). transfer(4) debits account 1, re-reads it, and credits account 2 — the block completes, so it COMMITs (6 / 4). transfer(100) debits account 1 to -94 and then `fail`s from inside an `if` nested in the block — the block ROLLs BACK before the fail returns, so account 1 is back to 6 and account 2 is untouched (4), and the `!{}` arm sees ::InsufficientFunds. Pre-S450 the block did not parse in a function body (E-SCOPE-001), and the pre-S450 lowering rolled back only before a `fail` that was a DIRECT child of the block (a `fail` in an `if` left the transaction open).
rationale: §19.10.2's normative example is a `transaction { }` in a `!` function whose `fail` sits inside an `if`. §19.10.3: "The compiler SHALL emit ?{BEGIN} at the start of the block, ?{COMMIT} at the end of normal completion, and ?{ROLLBACK} before any fail statement within the block." §19.10.4: "No transaction SHALL be left open." g-transaction-block-not-recognized-inside-a-function-body (S450).
